entries.title: Scope of exact metric KPZ
entries.statement: For each fixed gamma in (0,2), h a planar GFF, D_h its gamma-LQG metric, Q=2/gamma+gamma/2 and xi=gamma/d_gamma, the exact metric KPZ equality dim_E(X)=xi Q dim_D(X)-(xi^2/2)dim_D(X)^2 is proved for a deterministic Borel set X or a random Borel set independent of h. It cannot be applied unchanged to arbitrary h-dependent sets.
assumptions: X deterministic Borel or random Borel independent of h

source.excerpt: deterministic Borel set or a random Borel set independent from h

entries.title: Dimensions of gamma-thick points
entries.statement: For each fixed gamma in (0,2), with h a whole-plane GFF and D_h its gamma-LQG metric, the h-dependent set T_h^gamma of gamma-thick points has almost-sure Euclidean Hausdorff dimension 2-gamma^2/2 and D_h-Hausdorff dimension d_gamma. The first follows from the thick-point dimension formula with deterministic ambient C; the second is the full-dimension corollary.

entries.title: Thick-point counterexample to unrestricted metric KPZ
entries.statement: For every fixed gamma in (0,2), the h-dependent Borel set X=T_h^gamma refutes an extension of the independent-set metric KPZ equality to all random Borel sets. Its true Euclidean dimension is 2-gamma^2/2 and its metric dimension is d_gamma, whereas plugging d_gamma into that equality gives gamma Q-gamma^2/2=2. The discrepancy is gamma^2/2>0. This does not compute d_gamma or refute the correctly scoped theorem. Independently checked by w524 on 2026-10-10; proof uses Gwynne-Pfeffer equation (1.11) and Corollary 1.7.
assumptions: X is the gamma-thick-point set of the same field h that defines D_h

relations.rationale: Both dimensions of the same gamma-thick set are the inputs to the counterexample.
The counterexample explains why the theorem's independence premise cannot be erased.
